_comment: Density is the stress-test override. The minimal pipeline YAML uses 1.0e20 m^-3, 0.5 keV, and +40000 A on every coil. thermal_energy_density_J_m3 is null so temperature is not rewritten; a positive value would set temperature and keep density. Keys starting with _ are comments. Unknown slot names are rejected. conversion.shell_channel stays in the YAML.
